summary: First-finish smoke test for SertãoCast. All 13 backend endpoints pass (health, episodes list+category filter, admin login success/401, /auth/me with/without token, public booking create + duplicate 409, availability, admin bookings list, cancel/delete booking, POST /episodes admin vs 401, contact public + admin gate, /stats admin). Frontend home hero navigation, player bar, admin login (correct + wrong creds), tab switching, add episode button visibility, logout, episodes search+filter, and full public booking flow (date -> slot -> form -> success) all work end-to-end.
passed: GET /api/auth/me no token -> 401, with token -> 200 admin
GET /api/bookings no auth -> 401; with admin -> 200 list
POST /api/episodes no auth -> 401; admin -> 200 creates ep
Frontend home: 'A voz do Sertão' headline visible, hero-book-studio-button navigates to /agendar, hero-play-latest-button opens player bar
Frontend booking flow end-to-end: booking-date-*, booking-time-slot-*, booking-name/email/phone/podcast-input, booking-submit-button -> booking-success-message rendered
Frontend episodes page: episode-search-input + episode-filter-musica visible and clickable
Frontend admin: correct login navigates to /admin/dashboard, all 3 tabs (bookings/episodes/messages) visible, admin-add-episode-button visible, admin-logout-button returns to /admin
Nav links (nav-home-link, nav-episodes-link, nav-about-link, nav-contact-link) navigate correctly

failed.issue: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Cosmetic dev warning caused by editor instrumentation wrapping option children in span. Does not break functionality.
failed.evidence: Console error 'In HTML, %s cannot be a child of %s. This will cause a hydration error.' on /agendar page; booking flow still completes successfully.

failed.issue: React warning 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (AdminLogin)' on /admin. Non-blocking; login and redirect still work.
failed.evidence: Console warning during AdminLogin render; user reaches /admin/dashboard after submit.

failed.issue: Could not positively confirm the error toast for wrong credentials via generic [role=status]/.Toastify selectors (count=0). Login form did NOT proceed to dashboard on wrong creds (correct behavior), so gating works; only the toast visibility check was inconclusive.
failed.evidence: toast_wrong count=0 with generic selectors; needs specific toast data-testid to verify reliably.
